name: Klaviyo
description: Email/SMS marketing and CRM platform for consumer brands with REST APIs for profiles, events, campaigns, flows, segments and catalogs.
access_notes: Anyone with a Klaviyo account (free tier available) can create scoped private API keys self-serve for server-side /api endpoints; public key (site ID) is used for client-side endpoints. For tech partners / marketplace apps, Klaviyo requires OAuth (authorization code with PKCE) - creating an OAuth app in the Developer Console is self-serve, though App Marketplace listing itself requires review and 5+ active users.
mcp_notes: Official Klaviyo MCP server, GA since Aug 2025: remote-hosted at https://mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp (OAuth) plus a local uvx package using a private API key. Composio KLAVIYO toolkit also exists (225 tools, API key or OAuth2, not Composio-managed).

evidence.note: Three auth methods documented: private API keys and OAuth for server-side APIs, public key for client-side; OAuth required for App Marketplace apps
Private key auth via 'Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key' header with API key scopes; get-started flow is set up an account, obtain credentials, authenticate
Official Klaviyo MCP server docs: remote server at https://mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp and local server config, with read-only and toolset filtering options
Webhooks API: create webhook subscriptions with topics and HMAC-SHA256 signed deliveries
Composio toolkit catalog lists KLAVIYO: 225 tools, API_KEY and OAUTH2 auth schemes
